name: Wallenberg Advanced Scientific Forum, Autumn 2026
details: Workshop exploring symmetries in neural networks from a broad perspective.  Strong focus on collaborative problem-solving across career stages and beyond the own area of expertise.

name: GeUmetric Deep Learning Workshop 2026
details: Workshop on geometric methods in deep learning; also including perspectives of applications to physics, chemistry and biology.

name: Metric Algebraic Geometry
details: Workshop with many aspects to metric, integral and probabilistic algebraic geometry, sometimes with motivation from ML or data science. You can find some recordings on IML's webpage.

name: Algebraic aspects of Metric and Integral Geometry
details: School about o-minimal geometry, probabilistic intersection theory and integral geometry with subsequent conference.
